turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail: Cover the base with YETI Ice Blocks. - Add large ice cubes or blocks of ice on top of the YETI Ice Blocks or YETI Ice Sheets. - Pre-chill your food and drinks before packing them. - Use a 2:1 ratio of ice to chilled contents. - Fill leftover space with towels, rags or additional ice to reduce warm air. - Limit how often you open the cooler. - Keep it covered and out of direct sunlight when possible. - Don’t drain the melted ice, unless exposed food or meat could come into contact with the water.
